issues.title: Lag on server(s)
issues.body:
Discovered this during one of the minigames (Hypixel says) on the Hypixel server, where one is required to quickly fill their inventory. The fastest way is to hold down the right click and sweep the item across your inventory. Ever since I installed the mod, I experience a lag where some slots appear as though the item was placed there, but a frame later turns out it wasn't. I have attached a link to the video(github isn't letting me upload it) demonstrating how it looks with and without the mod. I only tested this on Hypixel, singleplayer, and my realm, and it only seems to happen on Hypixel out of these three; I did not test on any other server. I could say maybe it is because my ping is high, but again, with the mod turned off, everything works fine, and the minigame where I discovered the bug registers just fine that I did in fact fill up all the slots. 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NV86Uqg7cg9xqnuIt-cNAXCI7HW0VRiH/view?usp=sharing

Currently, I can do the following:
1. Click the item located in slot A
2. Move the cursor to where the slot B is
3. Click again to drop the item

1. Click the item at slot A and then hold the button
2. Move the cursor to slot B
3. Release button to drop the item

 * Create a Minecraft instance with Forge, MouseTweaks, JEI, and Quark (and AutoRegLib, a Quark dependency).
 * Start a creative-mode world.
 * Open a crafting table and fill your inventory with items cheated from JEI.
    * ![2019-01-11_23 17 34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/916092/51070518-737a2180-15f7-11e9-8d7f-e1ce63d47491.png)
 * Open a crafting recipe that can be shift-clicked into the crafting table, the [+] button must be above an item in your inventory if the recipe gui was not open.

 * Shift click the [+] button and observe extra items are moved into the crafting grid.
    * ![2019-01-11_23 17 44](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/916092/51070525-842a9780-15f7-11e9-9079-ae2a0c204843.png)

Quark moves items into the crafting grid with its "Better Craft Shifting" feature, but there is no conflict between just JEI and Quark. 
Mouse Tweaks must be present to cause the issue seen here, if it's not there then the shift-click puts the recipe into the crafting table without any extra items.

I do not know why this is happening, so I am hoping to try to figure it out with you and @vazkii

issues.title: Document how to deal with InvocationTargetException
issues.body:
Mouse Tweaks clicks the containers' slots via reflection, so when the container code throws, the crash log looks kinda like it was Mouse Tweaks which crashed. There have been multiple crash reports (#14, #7) which were actually bugs in the container, but were erroneously thought to be caused by Mouse Tweaks due to the unclear logs.

It should be documented somewhere (perhaps in the issue template? And also in the `handleMouseClick() threw an exception when called from MouseTweaks.` message?) that those kinds of crashes are usually not Mouse Tweaks' fault, and where to find the relevant stack trace.
